products.title: Heavyweight Tee
products.description: A 6.0 oz ring-spun cotton tee with real body — the blank for retail-quality merch, heavy prints and anything that has to feel like more than a promo shirt. Side-seamed, shoulder-taped, with a tight, smooth face that lays ink down flat.
products.seoTitle: Heavyweight Tee — 6.0 oz blank for decorators | Blankstock
products.seoDescription: A 6.0 oz ring-spun, side-seamed blank tee built for retail-quality prints. Sold by the case, priced per unit.

products.title: Ringspun Tee
products.description: A 4.3 oz combed ring-spun tee — soft, light and fashion-fit, the everyday blank for fine-line prints and DTG. Thinner than the heavyweight without going sheer, with a smooth face that holds detail. The volume workhorse of the shelf.
products.seoTitle: Ringspun Tee — 4.3 oz soft blank for DTG & fine prints | Blankstock
products.seoDescription: A soft 4.3 oz combed ring-spun blank tee, fashion-fit, ideal for DTG and fine-line prints. Priced per unit.

products.title: Long-Sleeve Tee
products.description: A 5.5 oz long-sleeve tee with rib cuffs that hold their shape through a wash — a print surface front, back and down both sleeves. Side-seamed and set-in, the same clean face as the heavyweight for full-coverage jobs.
products.seoDescription: A 5.5 oz side-seamed long-sleeve blank with rib cuffs and a clean print face front, back and sleeves.

products.title: Tank Top
products.description: A 4.2 oz ring-spun tank with a clean, deep armhole and bound neck and straps — the summer-drop and gym blank. Smooth face for a crisp front print, side-seamed so it sits flat on the platen.
products.seoTitle: Tank Top — 4.2 oz ring-spun blank | Blankstock
products.seoDescription: A 4.2 oz side-seamed ring-spun blank tank with bound neck and straps — the summer and gym blank.

products.title: Pullover Hoodie
products.description: An 8.5 oz fleece pullover hoodie — brushed inside, dense enough for a heavy front print, with a double-lined hood, split kangaroo pocket and rib cuffs and hem. The blank that carries a whole winter drop.
products.seoTitle: Pullover Hoodie — 8.5 oz fleece blank | Blankstock
products.seoDescription: An 8.5 oz brushed-fleece pullover hoodie blank with a double-lined hood — built for heavy front prints.

products.title: Crewneck Sweatshirt
products.description: An 8.0 oz fleece crewneck — the clean-canvas fleece, no hood, no pocket, just a smooth brushed-back panel front and back for embroidery or a big print. Set-in sleeves, rib collar, cuffs and hem that keep their shape.
products.seoTitle: Crewneck Sweatshirt — 8.0 oz fleece blank | Blankstock
products.seoDescription: An 8.0 oz brushed-fleece crewneck blank — a clean front and back panel for embroidery or a big print.

products.title: Structured Cap
products.description: A structured six-panel cap with a mid-profile crown that stands up for a clean embroidery face, a pre-curved visor and an adjustable snap back that fits one size to most. The headwear blank that finishes a merch line.
products.seoTitle: Structured Cap — six-panel blank for embroidery | Blankstock
products.seoDescription: A structured mid-profile six-panel blank cap with a snap back — a clean, firm face for embroidery.

products.title: Cotton Tote
products.description: A 6 oz cotton canvas tote with reinforced handles and a flat, boxy front — a large, forgiving print area for a one-color logo or a full-bleed job. The add-on blank that lifts an order value and moves at events.
products.seoTitle: Cotton Tote — 6 oz canvas blank | Blankstock
products.seoDescription: A 6 oz cotton canvas blank tote with reinforced handles and a large flat print area. Priced per unit.
